verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms GitLab serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.gitlab.com/llms.txt, headed 'GitLab Documentation', which an agent can be pointed at directly. GitLab also publishes agent-oriented guidance: the Orbit skill gives AI coding agents structured instructions for querying GitLab data, and the raw OpenAPI 3.0 spec is machine-readable. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants), and independent or community corroboration that agents use it effectively.
